newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast light, heavy crudes ease, deals seen - FEB 12.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast light, heavy crudes ease, deals seen - FEB 12.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices slid Wednesday on a technical drop in WTI/Cushing markets, while California heavy grades dipped after several deals were heard done sharply lower, traders said.
Heavy crude fell on a combination of lower postings and talk of cargoes sold at 90 cents and $3.00 under postings.
Tosco's damaged refinery, which led to declaration of force majeure, kept adding heavy crude to the market.
Traders said Tosco on Wednesday sold 1,000 barrels-per-day of San Joaquin heavy crude to Shell for March delivery. Shell was unavailable for comment.
Traders said Texaco sold a larger supply to an unknown buyer for 90 cents Wednesday.
And with benchmark WTI prices falling, Chevron and Mobil cut their average posted prices for heavy prices crudes 75 cents, leaving outright values at $13.88/14.88 a barrel.
Meanwhile, Alaskan North Slope crude oil (ANS) fell with a technically driven-drop in WTI, while diffs stayed unchanged at $1.10 under, traders said.
